profile_text.body:
Gong is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA. The company describes itself as offering a "Revenue AI OS," a platform aimed at go-to-market organizations that combines what the site calls multimodal revenue signal processing, specialized AI agents, and purpose-built sales applications. Its stated capabilities include call analysis, deal coaching, pipeline risk prediction, automated handoffs, and churn prediction.

The company's core product, also called Gong, is categorized as a revenue intelligence AI tool covering call analysis and deal coaching. Named sub-products referenced on the site include Gong Engage, described as an AI-driven sales engagement tool, and Gong Enable, which includes an AI Trainer feature the site says allows teams to build training from their own customer conversations. The site quotes a customer citing 6,700 hours saved across call preparation, follow-up, and CRM updates, and a 32% lift in buyer response rates attributed to Gong's AI Tracker agent.

The held facts note that the product carries a flag for sensitive sales data exposure, which is a relevant consideration given the platform's handling of customer call recordings and communications. No litigation cases are recorded in the held facts. Two MCP server entries associated with the Gong name relate to SQLite database exploration tools listed under third-party registries, though their direct connection to Gong the company is not established by the available data.
